summary: Examples: 1232345345 | human_readable gives 1.15 GB, with true gives 1.15 Gb, and with unit='M' gives 1175.26 MB.
questions: What does human_readable output for 1232345345 bytes?
How do I show a size in MB with human_readable?

answer_card.title: human_readable examples
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
size: "{{ 1232345345 | human_readable }}"            # 1.15 GB
size_bits: "{{ 1232345345 | human_readable(true) }}"  # 1.15 Gb
size_MB: "{{ 1232345345 | human_readable(unit='M') }}" # 1175.26 MB
```
